info.title: UCell R1.0B API
info.description: UCell Core API — Rule Version R1.0B FROZEN

qualificationMemberNo.description: Public Member Number for the single unplaced Member-origin qualification.
Public Member Number for the single unplaced Member-origin qualification.

binaryParentBallNo.description: Immutable public Ball Number of the parent within this Tree.

gender.description: Version-neutral gender code; display labels are client/localization concerns.

query.description: Train A AnalyticsQuery; one supported metric and explicit AsOfContext. Unknown metrics, dimensions and filters return 422.

snapshot.description: Immutable aggregate generation. Required with after; query must match exactly.

code.description: Member-authorized immutable business Ball number; never a UUID.

monthReference.description: Asia/Taipei calendar month used for the Active projection.

activeInterval.description: Authoritative v3 Active interval for monthReference; null means no Active evidence.

memberNo.description: Immutable Asia/Taipei YYMM + monthly six-digit business member number.

membershipState.description: Null means pre-V1.1 legacy state has not been classified; never inferred from Qualification.

truncated.description: True means bounded response; further pagination is not yet available.

readAt.description: First persisted Person read evidence; not LINE read state.

pv.description: Checkout does not recognize PV; null.

total.description: Core authoritative decimal-string TWD product amount; never client-computed.

price.description: Display only; Create Order revalidates Core price.

available.description: Orderable by effective traceable product profile; does not confirm ERP stock.

monthlyRepurchaseStatus.description: Core recognition schedule status; frontend cannot derive Active entitlement.

bonusAmount.description: Unfinalized settlement is null, not zero.

name.description: Present only for a direct-sponsored visible Ball; an empty string means the holder identity is intentionally omitted.

binaryPositionNo.description: Decimal string; never converted to a JavaScript number.

hiddenBootstrapBoundary.description: A neutral upstream indicator only. It never identifies a hidden Company Bootstrap Ball.

carry.description: Authoritative settlement carry. Null while the read model is unavailable; never interpreted as zero.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason. The frontend must not derive missing Core values.

settlementMetrics.description: Availability of authoritative left/right volume and carry for the requested settlement period.

settlementScope.description: Exact immutable settlement evidence used for volume/carry. Null when no explicit finalized settlement scope was requested.

fullTree.description: Availability of the bounded, privacy-safe full Binary Tree read model.

amount.description: Null for unfinalized or absent lifecycle evidence.

finalAmount.description: Null until the settlement batch is FINALIZED.

payableAmount.description: Null until final settlement evidence exists.

total.description: Display DTO only; not input to mutation.

accessToken.description: Opaque UCell bearer, not LINE token.

idToken.description: LINE ID token; verified server-side, never logged or persisted raw

accepted.description: Explicit acceptance is required; false is never recorded as consent.

intent.description: Optional fixed intent marker; no Person, session or Qualification identifiers accepted.

name.description: Display name only; legal identity is immutable through Member API

phone.description: Contact data only; does not bind or authenticate an identity

qualificationId.description: Selected Qualification; server checks authenticated Person ownership on every request
Required for retail orders; for active packages this must match targetQualificationId.

packageVersionId.description: Published package version. When supplied, items are rejected and immutable package snapshots are created.

items.description: Retail product IDs and quantities. Mutually exclusive with packageVersionId.

selections.description: Exact package selection by versioned product rule profile.

sponsorCode.description: Untrusted Sponsor Ball candidate. Accepted only for a qualification package; server resolves it again and records evidence. It never creates a relationship for retail orders.

retailReferralCode.description: Optional WEB_MEMBER retail referral Ball candidate. Validation is non-binding; the server revalidates it only when the first attributed retail order is committed.

token.description: Opaque encrypted token from a server-issued referral URL

anonymousId.description: Anonymous browser identifier returned by the first landing; server generates it when absent.

transitionState.description: Opaque server-signed transition state returned by referral landing

code.description: Untrusted public Ball number. This read validates only; it never creates a retail attribution or Sponsor relationship.

sourceReferralToken.description: 分享歸因Token，Server只存Hash/解析結果

balance.description: Authoritative sum of append-only effects as a decimal string.

sponsorCode.description: Paper Sponsor Ball code. Resolved by the same server-side resolver as online qualification acquisition; UUID is never a public Sponsor Code.

evidenceHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the referenced immutable evidence artifact.

artifactReference.description: Governed object URI, build artifact reference, or immutable evidence identifier.

approvalReference.description: Required for FORMAL_UAT_EVIDENCE; identifies the approved execution authority.
